## Problem Statement

What problem does this feature solve? Describe the current behavior that
is missing, inadequate, or could be improved.

## Proposed Solution

Describe your proposed solution or approach.

## Alternatives Considered

What other approaches did you consider? Why did you reject them?

- [ ] Edition profiles

- [ ] CI / testing
- [ ] Other: ___

## Acceptance Criteria

What does "done" look like for this feature? How would you verify it works?

## Related

Link to any related ADRs, issues, or discussions.
